purpose: Exploratory target-domain hyperparameter and probability-calibration selection using development queries only
covid_development_queries: Use the existing 10 development queries, retaining the existing 40 evaluation queries
selection_objective: Mean query-average automatic error across validation folds, review fractions and seeds
label_cost: All development pairs are paid once, reused across candidate evaluations, and final human-labeled. Remaining budget buys labels on the other queries. Full-pool baselines may spend the same total budget anywhere in the pool.
scope: Existing benchmark outcomes have been inspected. These are exploratory adaptation experiments. ChatReport split repetitions overlap.
